verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; the cause is identified and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads delivered 43 purchases and $7,008.67 in revenue on $1,358.97 in spend — a solid 5.16 return on ad spend for the full period. However, the last 7 days saw a 46.78% drop in that return, confirmed by only 3 purchases and $126.78 in revenue over the final 3 days of the window versus 6 purchases and $1,146.39 in the 3 days prior. The top campaign, which carried 53% of total spend this period, shows the pattern of creative fatigue — flat spend against falling purchases — and ad creative is being refreshed this week to address it. Your Google Business Profile also went dark on November 1–2, cutting off local web clicks and calls, and that is being resolved now. Several planned milestones including subscribe-page rebuilds, CRM flows, and Tier 3 scaling are overdue and are being prioritised to strengthen the full funnel before next period.
